==¶ OBADIAH.==

{{Chapter|1|}}{{smaller block|[[#1:1|1]] The deſtruction of Edom, [[#1:3|3]] for their pride, [[#1:10|10]] and for their wrong vnto Iacob. [[#1:17|17]] The ſalutation and victory of Iacob.}}

{{Verse|1|1|notext=}}{{dropinitial|T|image=King James Bible (1611) page D3v (T).png|imgsize=100px}}He viſion of Obadiah: Thus ſaith the Lord GOD, concerning Edom; *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Ier. 49. 14.}} Wee haue heard a rumour from the {{LORD}}, and an ambaſſador is ſent among the heathen: Ariſe yee, and let vs riſe vp against her in battell.

{{Verse|1|2}} Behold, I haue made thee ſmall among the heathen: thou art greatly deſpiſed.

{{Verse|1|3}} ¶ The pride of thine heart hath deceiued thee: thou that dwelleſt in the clefts of the rocke, whoſe habitation {{smaller|is}}<section end="obadiah" /><noinclude></noinclude>
